remarks: Charming home once part of a majestic Greenwich estate is set on 2.03 picturesque acres framed by classic stone walls. Thoughtfully updated while preserving its timeless charm and intimate scale, the farmhouse-style home blends character with modern comfort. Sun-filled interiors feature hardwood floors throughout, an updated kitchen that opens seamlessly to the family room & dining area, ideal for everyday living. A separate living room offers additional gathering space, while a cozy den w/ fireplace provides an inviting ambiance.The home includes 4 BR & 2.5 BA highlighted by a spacious primary suite w/ an adjoining sitting room and an upstairs family/playroom. Outdoors, the setting is truly exceptional. A large level play area, pool, stone patio & charming gazebo ideally located less than three minutes from the hamlet of Glenville and less than ten minutes from Greenwich Ave, this special property combines character and everyday convenience with endless potential to expand.
